limitations: Unified monthly matrix contains 5 asset/metric series: CSI 300 PE-TTM, CSI 300 PB, S&P 500 PE-TTM, S&P 500 CAPE and CNY gold price. Only the first three are index PE/PB monthly series.
Missing target index metrics: Hang Seng PE-TTM, Hang Seng PB, NASDAQ 100 PE-TTM, NASDAQ 100 PB and S&P 500 PB.

NASDAQ 100 Siblis public page has month-end monthly updates but exposes only ten year-end history rows plus latest month; free API has selected index coverage and a handful of period-end snapshots. Full historical series is subscription data. Annual/public snapshots are not interpolated.

S&P 500 PB LENSE public page provides 12 recent monthly observations and annual values from 1999; this is insufficient for 60/120-month percentiles. Candidate observations are archived separately and excluded from the unified monthly matrix.

Hang Seng official public page exposes a month-end constituent performance report download entry and references Index360 registration for wider data; a long auditable monthly PE/PB raw series has not been verified.
CAPE and trailing PE are different metrics and must not be compared as if identical.
Gold has no PE/PB; monthly CNY spot price percentile is a price-history indicator, not intrinsic-value valuation.
No interpolation, forward filling, or extrapolation is applied; rolling percentile is blank until a full 60/120-month window exists.
Only completed calendar months are included in the unified matrix. The Multpl CAPE source labels monthly observations on the first calendar day of the month; the source label is retained.

CSI 300 PE/PB are Legu aggregate historical series retrieved through AkShare public endpoints; daily raw source files are retained, and monthly values are the last real source observation in each month.
S&P 500 DQYDJ PE-TTM uses monthly average index level divided by trailing twelve-month EPS; it is not the same sampling convention as month-end index ratios.
Hang Seng official Monthly Roundup PDFs show a five-year PE/dividend-yield chart but do not publish a machine-readable monthly numeric table on the accessible public page.

A public Guchacha HSI valuation page provides weekly valuation visualization and current PE/PB snapshot, but longer history windows are locked; it does not expose reusable long-span raw weekly observations in page text.

Scribd-hosted copies of historical HSI month-end weighted-average PE tables contain extensive historical rows, but carry all-rights-reserved notices and unclear provenance/redistribution rights; not ingested or redistributed.

Siblis NASDAQ 100 public page provides a monthly latest reading and chart but not the full monthly numeric history; its free API exposes sparse month-end snapshots, not a continuous monthly series. API data is © Siblis Research and non-commercial use only.

NASDAQ 100 current PE snapshots differ by source: Siblis 32.76 (2026-10, aggregate normalized earnings), Guchacha 26.97 (2026-11-12), and WorldPEratio 29.83 (QQQ NAV proxy). These are methodologically distinct and must not be spliced.

NASDAQ 100.siblis_monthly_page: Latest monthly index-level reading through 2026-10; chart and year-end table are public, complete monthly numeric history is in subscription database
NASDAQ 100.siblis_method: Trailing P/E uses aggregate normalized net income over previous twelve months; major purely accounting gains/losses removed; point-in-time revisions retained
NASDAQ 100.free_api_scope: No key; only selected indices and a handful of historical month-end dates (documented examples include 2024-06-30, 2024-12-31, 2025-06-30, 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31); not monthly continuous
NASDAQ 100.free_api_license: Returned data © Siblis Research and permitted for non-commercial use; code samples MIT
NASDAQ 100.decision: Keep source-specific snapshots separate. Do not merge differing PE methodologies. Free API snapshots too sparse for rolling 60/120-month percentile; full Siblis series subscription.

S&P 500|PB.limitation: Recent monthly panel has only 12 observations; annual history cannot be converted to monthly observations. Candidate observations are archived separately; no rolling 5Y/10Y percentile.

Hang Seng.source: Hang Seng Indexes; Guchacha; public historical archive leads
Hang Seng.official_public_material: Monthly Roundup includes a 5-year PE/dividend-yield chart; not downloadable numeric month-by-month values
Hang Seng.public_chart_method: site describes index aggregate mcw valuation; page exposes 1Y view while longer history ranges are locked
Hang Seng.historical_archive_lead: Scribd-hosted HSI month-end weighted-average PE table reports 1973-07 through 2016-07 or 2020-01 depending on copy, but copy is all-rights-reserved, provenance and redistribution rights are not established; excluded from ingestion
Hang Seng.decision: Do not transcribe or redistribute Scribd copy; do not digitize values from chart images. Need official licensed/public downloadable numerical history or an explicitly permissive dataset.
